data.body:
IMPLEMENTED — Gerrit change 1586 (worktree b2bb-compact-split). NOT yet claimed: the
claim gate needs a plan-review attestation and the review is still being earned (see below).

WHAT SHIPPED
compact.py 798 -> 275, a CLI facade over two engines:
  compact_txn.py     436  the locked transaction (_compact_locked) + the snapshot
                          primitives BOTH engines share
  compact_rebuild.py 235  rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log (the fsck repair path)

DEVIATION FROM THE ORIGINAL PLAN — the plan as written could not be built.
It placed _build_authorship_ledger / _snapshot_strip_keys / _git_author in compact_rebuild
and _git in compact_txn. But _compact_locked needs the first three and
rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log needs all four, so that split makes each module import the
other — a circular import. All four now live in compact_txn, giving
compact -> {txn, rebuild} and rebuild -> txn (acyclic), which also puts the repair path in
the natural position of depending on the normal path. The ticket description is updated.

THE 'NO TEST EDITS' AC WAS WRONG — corrected rather than worked around.
tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_negative.py patches _git and lock ON THE compact
MODULE OBJECT. _compact_locked now reads compact_txn's globals, so:
  * setattr(_compact, '_git', ...) silently stops applying — compaction SUCCEEDS and the
    test's rc==1 assertion is the only thing that catches it. This is the dangerous
    direction: a weaker assertion would have left a test passing while exercising nothing.
  * setattr(_compact.lock, ...) raises AttributeError (compact.py no longer imports lock).
Both were confirmed RED by running the suite against the split BEFORE touching the tests,
then repointed at the symbols' new home. No assertion weakened. This is the exact
module-object monkeypatch hazard AGENTS.md and story 5e53 warn about.

COUNTER CO-LOCATION IS NOW PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED
New test asserts get_rebuild_count() increments across a real rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log
call, through the RE-EXPORTED path. Verified by mutation: shadowing the counter in the
facade makes it read 0 instead of 1. Nothing else in the suite touched the counter, so this
was genuinely uncovered.

GATES: full suite 11820 passed / 155 skipped. All three complexity-baseline entries for
this file DROP OUT (decomposition put every function under threshold) — a pure shrink.
docs/env-vars.md regenerated: REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER moved with its function.
raw-git-write gate initially FAILED in CI — the extracted _commit_compaction /
_commit_rebuild helpers lost the function-level '# raw-git-ok:' marker that had covered
their call sites; markers restored and the gate is green.

PLAN REVIEW: two BLOCK verdicts so far, both legitimate and both fixed in the description —
(1) the plan claimed fsck.py imports rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log by name; it does not,
only a comment mentions it (fsck_repair.py and fsck_restore.py are the real consumers);
(2) the internal re-imports compact.py needs for its OWN retained functions were unstated,
and the counter AC was unprovable as written. A third review is in flight; it has twice hit
an LLM provider flake (LLMUnavailableError: exceeded maximum output retries).
